note: The 8 km generated terrain streamed around the camera, with its generated material maps and no scanned rocks (kept locally for their license, so not every machine has them). Hot paths: terrain tile streaming and placement on job workers (cpu:terrain_stream, jobs.completed), 208k placed objects and 93k far ones (terrain.placed_objects, gpu:scatter), 69 resident tiles (terrain.tiles), water (gpu:water), volumetric clouds (gpu:clouds), ground cover, temporal antialiasing (gpu:taa_resolve) and one walking navigation agent. It settles slowly: about 50 s natively.
